purpose: Offline deterministic policy evaluation using repository curated fixtures and authored synthetic scenarios. It is not traffic, production inventory, an engagement measure, or a quality/uplift estimate.

measuredBehavior.content: Only public name/summary and event/idea titles and notes; no category, tag, creator, or bookmark features.
measuredBehavior.scoring: Distinct normalized token overlap; at least two shared meaningful tokens; each matching seed contributes sharedCount minus one; total score capped at three.
measuredBehavior.limits: At most 64 meaningful distinct tokens per source, selected in alphabetical order; at most 50 exact current Likes, selected by catalog key. No title weighting or semantic matching.
measuredBehavior.position: Affinity is a tie-break after editorial priority, within identical relevance vectors and before catalog key; creator diversity and recent-item promotion follow.
measuredBehavior.recentInteraction: The baseline recent-item opportunity is not a personalized top-K share cap: a recent item that earns an ordinary position through Like affinity keeps it there.

repositoryCuratedFixture.label: Actual repository curated starter fixtures; not production inventory.

noHistory.description: No Like rows; exact baseline ordering must remain unchanged.

denseThreeLikes.description: Three independent exact current Likes, scoped to one synthetic account.

unliked.description: A previously stored unliked state contributes no seed or boost.

revisedLike.description: A Like bound to an older source revision is rejected.

withdrawnSource.description: A Like whose source is absent from the current public catalog is rejected.

otherAccount.description: A separate account profile with a distinct Like set; profiles never combine.

syntheticAuthoredScenarios.definition: Seven hand-authored catalog-like text examples with a repeated creator, one lower-relevance candidate, and an intentionally stuffed keyword source, plus a 28-item mixed old/recent creator scenario.

oneSeed.description: One seed matches a repeated-creator inventory; affinity cannot cross a lower-relevance barrier.

keywordStuffing.description: A source with more than 64 distinct meaningful tokens is capped after deterministic alphabetical token ordering.

separateProfile.description: A different profile with no seed remains at baseline order.

evaluation.description: Twenty old and eight recent synthetic authored items from repeated creators; affinity ordering and the baseline recent-item pass operate together.

caveats: Like profile rows are fixture inputs, not observed account behavior.
Token overlap is a transparent lexical heuristic and can miss relevant items or match coincidental terms.
No preference text or raw content is written to this report; keys shown are curated fixture or synthetic evaluation keys.
This evaluation does not establish user preference quality, engagement improvement, or production readiness.
